subject: Quick follow-up after Cloud FinOps Summit — schedule a short demo
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@finopsinc.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up from Cloud FinOps Summit — 20-min demo?

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for stopping by the Redwood booth at the Cloud FinOps Summit yesterday — really enjoyed our quick conversation about cost observability and model caching for inference workloads. I wanted to follow up and see if you’d be open to a short 20–30 minute demo so we can show concrete savings we’ve seen for other FinOps teams.

Suggested times (PST):
- Wed Dec 2 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed Dec 2 — 15:00–15:30
- Thu Dec 3 — 09:00–09:30

If none of those work I’m happy to send a calendar link. Agenda: quick intro (5), demo of cost/perf dashboard + live Q&A (20), next steps (5). I’ve attached a one-page Quickstart that summarizes the integration and typical ROI.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-Quickstart.pdf
From: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@finopsinc.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from Cloud FinOps Summit — 20-min demo?

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — great to meet you as well. Those slots look good in general but I’m traveling early Wednesday morning (red-eye) and prefer Thu afternoon. Could we do Thu Dec 3 at 14:00 PST instead? I’m based in SF but will be onsite with our engineering lead that week. If Jordan or someone from product wants to join, that’d be great.

Also, would be helpful to see an example of the per-route cost breakdown and how Redwood recommends batching/quantization for a mixed workload.

Best,
Alicia Chen
Director of Platform Engineering
FinOps Inc.
Phone: +1 (617) 555-0127

Perfect — Thu Dec 3 at 14:00 PST works. I’ve put Jordan (AE) and Dev (Solutions Engineer) on the thread so we can cover pricing and the technical integration.

I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda + an invite ICS; please confirm the attendee list looks right. TL;DR agenda:
- 5m intros & goals (Alicia + Redwood)
- 15m demo: routing, per-route cost breakdown, batching suggestions
- 10m technical Q&A + next steps

Quick answers to your two asks:
- Per-route cost breakdown: we’ll show the Console view that surfaces token-level breakdowns and model routing decisions for mixed workloads.
- Batching/quantization: Dev will show sample config suggestions based on sequence-length histograms and expected QPS.

Attachments: demo-invite.ics

See you then — feel free to ping me if you need to move the time.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
